summary: Create team AI policies, prompt libraries, and risk controls with practical generative and agentic AI deployment training. Explore the course.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who supervise AI-assisted work and need practical controls that fit team workflows, internal governance, and legal review.
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. Familiarity with a team workflow and responsibility for operational, product, compliance, privacy, or digital decisions will help you apply the exercises.
